name: VF-Ray-GPU
definition: A GPGPU implementation of the VF-Ray algorithm using CUDA to parallelize ray casting on unstructured tetrahedral volumes, designed to reduce memory footprint by avoiding explicit adjacency structures like Use_set.
summary: VF-Ray-GPU is a memory-efficient GPU ray casting algorithm that avoids explicit adjacency structures by computing face parameters on-the-fly and parallelizing visibility determination across CUDA kernels.
